versions.changelog:
Initial release: cross-platform Sphero Mini control via Bluetooth LE

- Control Sphero Mini robot ball using Python and bleak on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
- Supports rolling, LED color/backlight control, battery status, heading reset, and power management.
- Includes pre-built scripts: random cat play mode, draw shapes (square, star), and color setting.
- Troubleshooting tips, installation, and quick start examples provided.
- For Sphero Mini only; not compatible with other Sphero models.
